purpose: Scope guard for a strong-L1 lower bound of the original first-event exit subsource; not a weak endpoint test or actual geom history sample
early_cutoff: (12+floor(log2(n)/2))/n; all three n are powers of two
receiver_channels: one disjoint channel per nonempty visited mask, evaluated at s=|A|/n, outer coordinate cutoff n
arithmetic: exact Python integers/Fraction; hashes store large integers without decimal serialization
claims_checked: D_n exact full Bernstein coefficient peak sum
original w peak/tail coarse probability floor is consistent with epsilon
first-event omitted source upper mass is late probability plus 2/n
strong potential lower is at least (D_n-1)/32
strong potential lower squared is at least n/128^2
not_checked: No numerical sampling or interval evaluation of G_c
No full actual FIRST, CPGP, hardwinner, hardband or source history certification
No rerun of old D_n experiments
